name: magebitcom/magento2-mcp-hyva-commerce-tools

suggest.hyva-themes/commerce-module-menu-builder: ^1.1: enables the hyva_menu.* tools and the menu health widget
suggest.hyva-themes/commerce-module-image-editor: ^1.1: reports Image Editor backups in hyva_media.image.get
suggest.hyva-themes/commerce-module-media-galler: ^1.0 (installed with commerce-module-cms 1.3): enables the hyva_media.asset/trash/folder/sync tools and asset ids in content
suggest.hyva-themes/commerce-module-ai-worker: ^1.0: enables the hyva_ai.* job monitoring tools
suggest.hyva-themes/commerce-module-advanced-adm: ^1.0: hyva_admin_perm.* reads; MCP callers get their union/deny roles in Hyvä checks
